name: TeamStarWolf - China-Attributed Threat Actors Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK techniques that the verified public record on China-attributed threat actors supports: the technique ids named in joint government advisories AA21-200A, AA22-158A, AA23-144A, AA24-038A, AA24-190A and AA25-239A, and the 30 techniques ATT&CK v20.0 records most often across the 46 China-attributed groups in the library data. Ids reported under earlier ATT&CK versions are shown under their v20.0 successors from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/THREAT_ACTORS_CHINA.md. Every technique scores 100: each is named in at least one of the six advisories, including all 30 of the most shared techniques.
